# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 01 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Policy Updates

- **15-month wait-out period for private property owners buying HDB resale flats removed** - The Government has removed the 15-month wait-out period with immediate effect, allowing eligible private residential property owners to right-size into an HDB resale flat without waiting, following signs that the HDB resale market has stabilised after several years of rapid price growth. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/15-month-period-removed-for-private-property-owners-buying-hdb-resale/)

- **Revised ABSD rules give developers up to seven years to complete large en bloc redevelopment projects** - From 29 July, developers redeveloping large en bloc sites get extended timelines under revised ABSD rules, with new sales deadlines and unit ratio requirements affecting both developers and en bloc site owners. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/developers-face-easier-time-selling-large-enbloc-projects-but-not-sure-win-for-en-bloc-hopefuls/)

- **Property agents must complete at least three qualifying transactions from 2027; CEA extends registrations to three years** - From 1 January 2027, property agents in Singapore will need to complete at least three qualifying property transactions over a three-year registration period or pass an assessment, as part of new CEA currency requirements announced on 28 July 2026. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/property-agents-must-meet-new-transaction-requirement-from-2027-cea-extends-registrations-to-three-years/)

## New Launch & Resale Market

- **Dunearn House sells 56% of units at launch, averaging S$3,140 psf** - The 380-unit Dunearn House sold 212 units during its launch weekend, marking a solid debut as the first private residential development within the upcoming Bukit Timah Turf City precinct. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/dunearn-house-sells-212-units-averaging-3140-psf-at-launch/)

- **Condo resale volumes rebounded in June 2026 as buyers returned to the secondary market** - Singapore's private resale condominium market remained steady in June 2026, with prices holding largely flat while transaction volumes picked up, reflecting a period of stabilisation with few signs of either strong acceleration or a slowdown. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-volumes-rebounded-in-june-2026-as-buyers-returned-to-the-secondary-market/)

## HDB Resale Spotlight

- **S$490,000 for a 2-room flat in Dawson — the cheapest in the new cluster** - A newly MOP 2-room HDB flat in Dawson, Queenstown recently changed hands for S$490,000, described as the cheapest in the new Dawson cluster, reflecting how sought-after newer flats in the area have become. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/490k-2-room-flat-is-the-cheapest-in-new-dawson-hdb-cluster/)
